_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Critical Safety Item, Characteristic and Critical Defect Report
summary: Specifies preparation instructions for a report identifying components, assemblies, and processes with critical characteristics and documenting critical defect occurrences, investigation results, and corrective actions.
use_relationship:
The Critical Safety Item, Characteristic and Critical Defect Report identifies components, assemblies and processes with one or more critical characteristics that if not conforming to the design data or quality requirements would result in an unsafe condition.  This report also identifies the occurrence(s) of critical defects, event rates, investigation results, corrective action and notification actions.

a.  This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.

b.  This DID supersedes DI-SAFT-80970.

c.  This DID is applicable to the acquisition of designs or hardware with items considered to have, or potentially have, critical parts or characteristics in the technical data package.

d.  This DID may be tailored on DD Form 1423 for the particular acquisition.  If the acquisition includes both design and hardware, tailoring may not be necessary.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: General
preparation_instructions.content: Definitions applicable to this DID are as follows:

children.title: Critical Item
children.content: A part, assembly, installation, or production process with one or more critical characteristics that, if not conforming to the design data or quality requirements, would result in an unsafe condition.

children.title: Critical Characteristics
children.content: Any feature (e.g., tolerance, finish, material composition, manufacturing, assembly, inspection process) of product, material, or process, which if nonconforming or missing could cause the failure or malfunction of the critical item.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Safety Report shall be in contractor format.  Hard copy submittals shall be on 8 1/2 by 11-inch bond paper.  Electronic/computer generated reports approved by the procuring activity shall be printable in the same format.  When necessary to provide clarification (e.g., identification of the items, parts, assemblies, and materials); detailed diagrams, drawings, sketches, photographs, etc. shall be included in conjunction with the text.  When consistent with an effective presentation, the contractor-selected format used in the initial submission shall be used for subsequent submissions.

preparation_instructions.title: Content for Design
preparation_instructions.content: The Safety Critical Items/Characteristics Report content shall be as follows:

children.title: Title Page
children.content: The title page shall identify the contract number, the reporting period, and the date of the report.

children.title: Table of Contents
children.content: The table of contents shall identify the major topics addressed in the report.

children.title: Critical Item Characteristics List
children.content: The lists shall identify the following elements:

children.title: Critical item identification
children.content: including the part number, nomenclature, and National Stock Number.

children.title: The Commercial and Government Entity Code (CAGEC)
children.content: that identifies the manufacturer of the critical item.

children.title: Analytical data and results
children.content: which support the determination that an item and associated characteristics are critical.

children.title: Documents which control the critical characteristics
The service life, if established, for the critical item
The most effective inspection method to be performed on the critical item to inspect for the critical characteristics
children.content: The inspection method shall include any applicable test requirements (e.g., test equipment, test conditions, detailed test procedures, test results).

preparation_instructions.title: Content for Report of Hardware Containing Critical Safety or Critical Defect

children.title: Prime Contractor name and contract number
Detailed Investigation
children.content: Investigation Information shall include: A narrative description of the detailed investigation and analysis of the critical defect.  The narrative shall include the root cause of the defect, evidence that the segregated material is not affected and corrective action(s) taken to eliminate the defect in remaining material and to preclude recurrence.

children.title: Segregated Material Use and Restart Request
Reference to the approved notification, detailed investigation and corrective action(s)
Identify of material, lot number, and quantity
Narrative request for use or restart authority
